```{r}
#| include: false
# Load required libraries
library(highcharter)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(colorspace)
library(htmltools)

dark_accent <- "#242c3d"


astho_theme <- hc_theme(
  chart = list(
    backgroundColor = NULL),
  style = list(
    fontFamily = "Jost",
    fontSize = '1.2em'),
  title = list(
    style = list(
      color = dark_accent,
      fontFamily = "Jost",
      fontWeight = "bold")),
  subtitle = list(
    style = list(
      color = dark_accent,
      fontFamily = "Jost")),
  caption = list(
    style = list(
      color = "#666",
      fontFamily = "Jost")),
  xAxis = list(
    labels = list(
      style = list(
        fontFamily = "Jost",
        fontSize = "1.25em",
        fontWeight = "normal",
        color = "#666")),
    title = list(
      style = list(
        color = dark_accent,
        fontFamily = "Jost"
        # ,
        # fontWeight = "500"
      ))),
  yAxis = list(
    labels = list(
      style = list(
        fontFamily = "Jost",
        fontWeight = "normal",
        color = "#666")),
    title = list(
      style = list(
        color = dark_accent,
        fontFamily = "Jost",
        fontWeight = "500"
      ))),
  legend = list(
    itemStyle = list(
      fontFamily = "Jost",
      color = dark_accent,
      fontWeight = "normal",
      color = "#666"),
    title = list(
      style = list(
        textDecoration = "underline",
        fontFamily = "Jost"
      ))),
  tooltip = list(
    padding = 10,
    borderRadius = 20,
    backgroundColor = "#fff",
    style = list(
      fontFamily = "Jost",
      maxWidth = "50%",
      whiteSpace = "normal")),
  useHTML = TRUE
) #end of code for the astho theme



```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

create_palette_chart <- function(palette, palette_name) {
  
  colors <- unname(palette)
  

  # Prepare data for chart
  data <- tibble(
    color = colors,
    name = map_chr(colors, ~ifelse(is.null(color_lookup[[.x]]$name), "Unknown", color_lookup[[.x]]$name)),
    hex = colors,
    y = 100,
    blackWCAG = colorspace::contrast_ratio(hex, "black", algorithm = "WCAG"),
    whiteWCAG = colorspace::contrast_ratio(hex, "white", algorithm = "WCAG"),
    blackAPCA = map_dbl(colors, ~{
      colorspace::contrast_ratio(.x, "black", algorithm = "APCA")[1, "reverse"]
    }),
    whiteAPCA = map_dbl(colors, ~{
      colorspace::contrast_ratio(.x, "white", algorithm = "APCA")[1, "reverse"]
    })
  )
  
  data <- data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      name = paste(name, "<br> <b>", hex, "</b>"),
      textColor = dplyr::case_when(
        blackWCAG > whiteWCAG ~ "#000000",
        blackWCAG < whiteWCAG ~ "#ffffff"
      ),
      
      textColorText = dplyr::case_when(
        textColor == "#000000" ~ "black",
        textColor == "#ffffff" ~ "white"
      ),
      
      tooltipText = paste0(
      "<b>", hex, "</b> <br>",
      "Best text color: <b>", textColorText, "</b> <br>"
      
      # "WCAG Contrast (Black/White):", round(blackWCAG, 1), "/", round(whiteWCAG, 1), "<br>",
      # "APCA Contrast (Black/White):", round(blackAPCA, 1), "/", round(whiteAPCA, 1)
    )

    ) |>
    dplyr::select(c(name:y, tooltipText, textColor))
  
  
  # View(data)
  
  # Create chart with click event using hc_plotOptions
  hc <- highchart() %>%
    hc_add_theme(astho_theme)  %>%
    hc_add_dependency("modules/pattern-fill.js") %>%
    hc_chart(type = "column", data = data) %>%
    hc_title(text = palette_name, align = "left") %>%
    hc_xAxis(categories = data$name, 
             title = list(text = NULL)
             ) %>%
    hc_yAxis(title = list(text = ""), 
             min = 0, max = 100,
             labels = list(enabled = FALSE),
             gridLineWidth = 0) %>%
  
    hc_plotOptions(
      series = list(
        keys = c('hex', 'y', 'textColor'),
        hcaes(x = name, y = y, textColor = textColor),
        cursor = "pointer",
        point = list(
          events = list(
            click = JS("function() {
  var hex = this.hex;
  var tempTextArea = document.createElement('textarea');
  tempTextArea.value = hex;
  document.body.appendChild(tempTextArea);
  tempTextArea.select();
  tempTextArea.setSelectionRange(0, 99999);
  
  try {
    var successful = document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(tempTextArea);
    if (successful) {
      alert('Copied to clipboard: ' + hex);
    } else {
      alert('Copy failed. Try selecting and copying manually.');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    document.body.removeChild(tempTextArea);
    alert('Failed to copy: ' + err);
  }
}")         
            )
        ),

        dataLabels = list(
          enabled = FALSE,
          format = "{point.hex}",
          color = '{point.textColor}',
          style = list(
            fontSize = "1em",
            fontWeight = "bold",
            textOutline = "0px",
            color = data$textColor
          )
        )

      ),

      column = list(
        pointPadding = 0,
        groupPadding = 0,
        borderWidth = 1,
        borderColor = "#000000"
      )
    ) %>%
      hc_add_series(
      data = data,
      name = "Colors",
      keys = c('name', 'hex', 'y'),
      showInLegend = FALSE,
      colorByPoint = TRUE,
      type = "column"
      # ,
      # # hcaes(x = name, y = y, textColor = textColor, color = hex),
      # dataLabels = list(
      #   enabled = TRUE, 
      #   format = "{point.hex}",
      #   style = list(
      #       color = '{point.textColor}'
      #     )
      #   )
      # mapping = hcaes(labelColor = textColor)
      
    ) %>%
    
    hc_colors(colors) %>%
    hc_tooltip(
      useHTML = TRUE,
      # headerFormat = "{key}",
      pointFormat = "<i>Click to copy hex code!</i> <br> {point.tooltipText} 
      "
    ) %>%
    hc_exporting(enabled = FALSE) %>%
    hc_size(height = 250) 
  # |>
  #   hc_exporting(
  #   enabled = TRUE,
  #   width = 1200
  #   )
  
  return(hc)
}

# Create all charts in a list
all_charts <- list()

# Add categorical charts
for (name in names(categoricalPalettes)) {
  all_charts[[paste0("cat_", name)]] <- create_palette_chart(
    categoricalPalettes[[name]], name
  )
}

# Add sequential charts
for (name in names(sequentialDivergingPalettes)) {
  all_charts[[paste0("seq_", name)]] <- create_palette_chart(
    sequentialDivergingPalettes[[name]], name
  )
}

# Add dual charts
for (name in names(dualColorPalettes)) {
  all_charts[[paste0("dual_", name)]] <- create_palette_chart(
    dualColorPalettes[[name]], name
  )
}


# Add null and suppressed value charts
for (name in names(nullSuppressedColors)) {
  all_charts[[paste0("etc_", name)]] <- create_palette_chart(
    nullSuppressedColors[[name]], name
  )
}
```

```{r}
pattern_chart <- highchart() %>%
  hc_chart(type = "column") %>%
  hc_title(text = "Pattern Fills", align = "left") %>%
  hc_xAxis(
    categories = c("Diagonal Pattern", "Grid Pattern"), 
    title = list(text = NULL)
  ) %>%
  hc_yAxis(
    title = list(text = ""), 
    min = 0, max = 100,
    labels = list(enabled = FALSE),
    gridLineWidth = 0
  ) %>%
  hc_plotOptions(
    # series = list(
    #   cursor = "pointer",
    #   point = list(
    #     events = list(
    #       click = JS("function() {
    #         var patternName = this.name;
    #         var bgColor = '#ebebeb';
    #         var lineColor = '#a4a4a4';
    #         alert('Pattern: ' + patternName + 
    #               '\\nBackground: ' + bgColor + ' (Pearl Grey)' +
    #               '\\nLines: ' + lineColor + ' (Deep Grey)');
    #       }")
    #     )
    #   )
    # ),
    column = list(
      pointPadding = 0,
      groupPadding = 0,
      borderWidth = 1,
      borderColor = "#000000",
      dataLabels = list(
        enabled = FALSE,
        format = "{point.name}",
        style = list(
          fontSize = "1em",
          fontWeight = "bold",
          textOutline = "0px"
          # color = c("#000000", "#000000", "#000000")
        )
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  hc_add_series(
    data = list(
      list(
        y = 100, 
        name = "Diagonal Pattern",
        ppt = "Diagonal Stripes: Wide Downward",
        background = "Pearl Grey (#ebebeb)",
        foreground = "Deep Grey (#a4a4a4)",
        color = list(
          pattern = list(
            path = list(
              d = 'M0,0 l12,12 M-1,11 l6,6 M11,-1 l6,6',
              strokeWidth = 3.5
            ),
            backgroundColor ="#ebebeb", 
            color = "#a4a4a4",
            width = 12,
            height = 12
          )
        )
      ),
      list(
        y = 100, 
        name = "Grid Pattern",
        ppt = "Large Grid",
        foreground = "Pearl Grey (#ebebeb)",
        background = "Deep Grey (#a4a4a4)",
        color = list(
          pattern = list(
            path = list(
              d = 'M9,0 l0,18 M0,9 l18,0',
              strokeWidth = 1
            ),
            backgroundColor =  "#a4a4a4",
            color ="#ebebeb",
            width = 18,
            height = 18
          )
        )
      )
    ),
    name = "Patterns",
    showInLegend = FALSE
  ) %>%
  hc_tooltip(
    useHTML = TRUE,
    pointFormat = "Background: <b>{point.background}</b><br>
    Lines: <b>{point.foreground}</b> <br>
    Powerpoint Pattern Equivalent Name: <b>{point.ppt}</b>"
  )

# Load the pattern-fill module if needed
# You might need to add this dependency if patterns don't show
pattern_chart <- pattern_chart %>%
  hc_add_dependency("modules/pattern-fill.js") %>%
  hc_add_theme(astho_theme) %>%
  hc_size(height = 250)

# Display the chart
htmltools::browsable(pattern_chart)
```

```{=typst}
  "5-Color Sequential (multi-hue green)": ("#e8f3c0", "#c7e072", "#9ec371", "#74a76f", "#468c6c"),
  "5-Color Sequential (multi-hue purple-blue)": ("#ede2ef", "#dbc5e0", "#b2a9d5", "#878dca", "#5673be")
)

#let diverging-palettes = (
  "7-Color Diverging (blue & yellow-green)": ("#5e97d6", "#62bcf0", "#b0d7ed", "#e3e1d3", "#e8f3c0", "#c7e072", "#76933c"),
  "7-Color Diverging (green & purple)": ("#76933c", "#c7e072", "#e8f3c0", "#e3e1d3", "#f4e2f8", "#e9c5f1", "#a572b2"),
  "6-Color Diverging (blue & yellow-green)": ("#5e97d6", "#62bcf0", "#b0d7ed", "#e8f3c0", "#c7e072", "#76933c"),
  "6-Color Diverging (green & purple)": ("#76933c", "#c7e072", "#e8f3c0", "#f4e2f8", "#e9c5f1", "#a572b2")
)

#let dual-palettes = (
  "2 Category (Blues)": ("#62bcf0", "#29326a"),
  "2 Category (Purple Blue)": ("#a572b2", "#29326a"),
  "Indigo Highlight": ("#4c6dc1", "#e3e1d3"),
  "Purple Highlight": ("#a572b2", "#e3e1d3")
)

#let null-palettes = (
  "Supressed & Null Values": ("#ebebeb", "#a4a4a4", "#e3e1d3")
)

// Helper function to display color swatch with text below, constrained to square width
#let color-swatch-with-text(hex, square-size: 40pt) = {
  let info = get-color-info(hex)
  
  stack(
    dir: ttb,  // Changed from ltr to ttb for vertical stacking
    spacing: 4pt,
    // Square at specified size
    square(size: square-size, fill: rgb(hex)),
    // Text container constrained to same width
    block(
      width: square-size,
      inset: (x: 0pt, y: 2pt),
      text(
        size: 8pt,
        align(left, [
          #info.name
        ])
      )
    ),
    // Hex code in gray, also constrained
    block(
      width: square-size,
      text(
        size: 7pt,
        fill: black,
        align(center, [
          #hex
        ])
      )
    )
  )
}

// Display all palettes
#heading(level: 2)[Categorical Palettes]
#for (name, colors) in categorical-palettes {
  heading(level: 3)[#name]
  grid(
    columns: (auto,) * colors.len(),
    gutter: 8pt,
    ..colors.map(hex => color-swatch-with-text(hex, square-size: 50pt))
  )
}

#pagebreak()

#heading(level: 2)[Sequential Palettes]
#for (name, colors) in sequential-palettes {
  heading(level: 3)[#name]
  grid(
    columns: (auto,) * colors.len(),
```
